description: This file contains unit tests for the class ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter, verifying its immutability, null input handling, default behavior, acknowledgment label filtering, and integration with CreateThing commands.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing various behaviors of the ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToApplyNullCommand
methods.description: Ensures that applying null to the setter throws a NullPointerException with a specific message.

methods.name: doNothingIfNoResponseRequired
methods.description: Tests that if the response is not required, the command remains unchanged.

methods.name: addPersistedAckLabelByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that the default behavior adds a persisted acknowledgment label when response is requested.

methods.name: filterOutOtherBuiltInDittoAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Checks that only specific acknowledgment labels are retained when multiple labels are present.

methods.name: doNotAddPersistedAckLabelToAlreadyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Ensures that if acknowledgment labels already include certain labels, no additional labels are added.

calls: assertThatNullPointerException().isThrownBy(() -> underTest.apply(null)).withMessage('The command must not be null!')
